newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TWO MINERS DIE IN ROCKFALL AT JCI GOLD MINE.
newsitem.headline: TWO MINERS DIE IN ROCKFALL AT JCI GOLD MINE.

text.p: South African mining house JCI Ltd said two miners were killed after a rockfall at the North Section of its Western Areas Gold Mine on Tuesday.
JCI spokesman Marc Gonsalves said one of the victims died instantly following a strain burst at the mine, some 2,000 metres underground, while the other had died shortly after having been rescued.
Four other miners were wounded, two of them seriously, in the incident which occurred at around 1000 GMT.
"A full investigation, which will include the Department of Mineral Affairs personnel and union and employee safety representatives, has been initiated," Gonsalves said in a statement.
